description: Application for non-material amendment of planning permission dated 17/04/2026, ref: PA/24/02089. Non Material Amendment(s) Sought: Building cores and circulation: Reconfiguration of the approved core arrangement, including associated changes to staircases, lifts, risers and circulation routes to address updated fire safety requirements.  Shared living accommodation: Reconfiguration of internal room layouts informed by MORRO's operational experience. The overall number of shared living rooms remains unchanged at 212.  Communal amenity: Reconfiguration of communal facilities to improve their functionality and reflect operational requirements.  Ground floor and basement: Amendments to the arrangement of plant, servicing, cycle storage, refuse facilities, access and the electrical substation including changes arising from the revised ground floor level required to address flood risk.  Building section: Minor adjustments to internal floor-to-floor heights to improve the quality of the ground floor commercial accommodation following the increase in the approved ground floor level whilst retaining the approved overall building height.  Elevations: Minor consequential amendments to windows, doors, terraces and ground floor elevations arising from the revised internal arrangements and servicing requirements.
